notes: «و ما كان فيه عن أبي حبيب ناجية» opens the sentence as the book's heading; it is not a link, so the chain's last link is the second «أبي حبيب ناجية»
«رويته عن أبي» : the compiler's father is a bare relation (rule 7); the compiler himself is not written (owner ruling 1)
«- رضي اللّه عنه -» is an honorific, left out
